set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== SILENT NATIVE DTMF 1 STATIC COORDS ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo ref_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && OFF=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; sleep 6.0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 174 1826; sleep 0.45; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 186 986; echo native_digit1_tapped=true; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 3000 /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; echo silent_reference_capture=true

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; APK=$(cat /tmp/phase1c_apk_path); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo '=== SILENT PCM DTMF 1 CALL_ASSISTANT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pcm_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && OFF=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; V=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_VOICE_CALL' | head -n 10); printf '%s\n' "$V" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; sleep 6.0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe play-dual-tone 16000 300 697 1209 0.10"; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "2"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 3000 /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo '=== FOCUSED TX LOGCAT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -i -E 'CALL_ASSISTANT|incall_music|TELEPHONY_TX|getOutputForAttr|AudioTrack' | tail -n 180 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 0.8; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo silent_pcm_capture=true

set -e; echo '=== WAV METRICS ==='; python3 -c 'import hashlib,math,struct,wave; files=[("none","/tmp/phase1c_none.wav"),("ref","/tmp/phase1c_ref.wav"),("pcm","/tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav")]; data={}; rms=lambda s: math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in s)/max(1,len(s))); import itertools; [(lambda n,p:(lambda w:(lambda b:(data.__setitem__(n,struct.unpack("<%dh"%(len(b)//2),b)),print("%s_rate=%d %s_channels=%d %s_bytes=%d %s_sha256=%s %s_rms=%.2f"%(n,w.getframerate(),n,w.getnchannels(),n,len(b),n,hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),n,rms(data[n])))))(w.readframes(w.getnframes())))(wave.open(p,"rb")))(n,p) for n,p in files]; [(lambda a,b:(lambda n:print("mad_%s_%s=%.2f"%(a,b,sum(abs(data[a][i]-data[b][i]) for i in range(n))/max(1,n))))(min(len(data[a]),len(data[b]))))(a,b) for a,b in [("none","ref"),("none","pcm"),("ref","pcm")]]'; echo '=== NO-INPUT TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_none.wav || true; echo '=== REFERENCE TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav || true; echo '=== PCM TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav || true; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_none.wav /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav /tmp/phase1c_apk_path; echo phase1c_silent_threeway_dtmf_proof_complete=true
